lines.en: label day237:
scene watabesan1
I sit at my desk and begin to sort through a large packet of paperwork that was left for me by one of the[school] administrators.
lines.zh: 我坐在办公桌前，开始整理一位[school]行政人员留给我的一大摞文件。

lines.en: I’m not sure why they didn’t just send out an email with all of this information, but I’ve come to accept that nothing about this[school] is normal as-is, so why start changing that now?
lines.zh: 我不明白他们为什么不直接把这些信息发封邮件了事，但我早就接受了这所[school]没有一处正常这个事实，那又何必从现在开始改呢？

lines.en: Still, though, who would have thought simply transferring a bunch of students from one[school] to another would be such an issue?
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，谁能想到把一群学生从一所[school]转到另一所，会是这么麻烦的事？

lines.en: Oh, did I forget to mention that?
lines.zh: 哦，我忘了说这茬了吗？

lines.en: Right.
lines.zh: 对。

lines.en: Following the collapse of the[school] in the more urban section of town, students were given a number of options.
lines.zh: 在镇上更繁华那片区的那所[school]塌陷之后，学生们得到了好几个选择。

lines.en: The first (And probably the best option) was to simply attend a virtual classroom sort of thing until a new[school] could be constructed.
lines.zh: 第一个（大概也是最好的选择）是先上网课之类的虚拟课堂，一直上到新[school]建好为止。

lines.en: The second option, which a bunch of fucking idiots must have chosen because who would pass up the chance to learn from their bedroom?-
lines.zh: 第二个选项，肯定是一群他妈的傻子才会选的，因为谁会放过躺在自己床上上课的机会啊——

lines.en: Was the opportunity to transfer[school]s and carry out the rest of their education in none other than [kumon_mi_high].
lines.zh: 就是转[school]，在 [kumon_mi_high] 这地方念完剩下的书。

lines.en: Also, why is this[school] the one named [kumon_mi_high] when the other one is also in Kumon-mi as well?
lines.zh: 还有，另一所也在 Kumon-mi，凭什么就这所[school]叫 [kumon_mi_high]？

lines.en: This is stupid.
lines.zh: 这太蠢了。

lines.en: I close the packet and lean back in my chair, waiting for something interesting to happen as I always do.
lines.zh: 我合上文件夹，往椅背上一靠，像往常一样等着有什么有趣的事发生。

lines.en: Something interesting happens right away.
lines.zh: 有趣的事立刻就发生了。

lines.en: Sweet.
lines.zh: 不错。

lines.en: : Come in.
lines.zh: : 请进。

lines.en: scene watabesan2
: I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: : That’s...cool?
lines.zh: : 这……挺酷的？

lines.en: : Do we know each other?
lines.zh: : 我们认识吗？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 算不上。

lines.en: : Then why did you come to see me?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么来找我？

lines.en: : All of the other teachers left for the day and I needed someone to complain to.
lines.zh: : 其他老师今天都下班了，我需要找个人发发牢骚。

lines.en: : Other teachers?
lines.zh: : 其他老师？

lines.en: : So you’re a teacher as well?
lines.zh: : 那你也是老师？

lines.en: : Wakana Watabe.
lines.zh: : Wakana Watabe。

lines.en: : You inherited two of the misfits from my class and I never had the chance to thank you.
lines.zh: : 您接手了我班上两个异类，我一直没机会向您道谢。

lines.en: : Oh, Molly and Tsuneyo’s old teacher. You’re welcome, I guess.
lines.zh: : 哦，是 Molly 和 Tsuneyo 以前的老师啊。那……不客气。

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: : Yeah, you mentioned that when you first walked in.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你刚进门的时候就说过了。

lines.en: scene watabesan3
: Really, though...Why now?
lines.zh: : 说真的……为什么是现在？

lines.en: : Things would have been so much easier if everyone just died when that stupid[school] sunk into the ground.
lines.zh: : 要是那所破[school]沉进地里的时候大家都死了，事情会轻松得多。

lines.en: : We’re all going to die anyway, no point in sticking around and trying to avoid that.
lines.zh: : 反正我们都要死，何必还赖着不死、拼命躲呢。

lines.en: : I want to say that isn’t a very teacher-like thing to say, but I’m in the same boat.
lines.zh: : 我本想说这可不像一个老师该说的话，但我自己也是半斤八两。

lines.en: scene watabesan4
: So you also wake up every morning and struggle to get out of bed and resign yourself to yet another miserable day of misery and...misery?
lines.zh: : 所以您每天早上醒来，也是挣扎着爬下床，然后认命地迎接又一个悲惨、充满悲惨的……悲惨的一天？

lines.en: : More or less, yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，嗯。

lines.en: : Then I shall confide in you from now on as no one else seems to understand me in this god-forsaken[school].
lines.zh: : 那我从今往后就向您倾诉了，因为这所被神遗弃的[school]里，似乎没有别人懂我。

lines.en: : That’s fine I guess. Count me in.
lines.zh: : 那也行吧。算我一个。

lines.en: scene watabesan5
: I will begin to draft our double-suicide note right away.
lines.zh: : 我这就开始起草我们的双人自杀遗书。

lines.en: : Okay, maybe don’t count me in. I didn’t realize that’s what I was signing up for.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那还是别算我一个了。我不知道我签的原来是这种东西。

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: It seems this transfer-process has really started weighing on Ms. Watabe.
lines.zh: 看来这次转学流程真的开始压垮 Watabe 老师了。

lines.en: Or she’s just like this all the time.
lines.zh: 或者她平时就这副德行。

lines.en: I really have no idea.
lines.zh: 我真的搞不清楚。

lines.en: scene watabesan6
: Can I count on you to take all of the weird girls out of my class if we’re really going to be doing this transfer-thing?
lines.zh: : 如果真要搞这个转学的事，我能指望您把我班上那些怪女生全接走吗？

lines.en: : My room is already full of pathetic miscreants and I’ve heard that you handle that type of student well.
lines.zh: : 我那教室已经塞满了可悲的问题学生，而我听说您对付这类学生很有一手。

lines.en: : What? Where did you hear that?
lines.zh: : 什么？您从哪儿听说的？

lines.en: : Teenage girls talk too much. It’s annoying.
lines.zh: : 十几岁的女生话太多了。烦死人。

lines.en: : I hear a bunch of things about the operation you’re running.
lines.zh: : 关于您在搞的那摊子事，我听到不少风声。

lines.en: : It also sounds a lot like you could get fired if any part of it is true.
lines.zh: : 听上去只要有一句是真的，您就够被开除的了。

lines.en: : You’re not going to rat me out if I don’t agree to taking on your “miscreants,” are you?
lines.zh: : 如果我不答应接收您的「问题学生」，您不会去告发我吧？

lines.en: : Oh, not at all. Do you have any idea how long and arduous that process would be?
lines.zh: : 哦，完全不会。您知道那套流程有多漫长、多麻烦吗？

lines.en: : Even showing up to[school] takes more energy than I’m willing to expend.
lines.zh: : 光是来[school]上班要花的力气，就已经超出我愿意付出的范围了。

lines.en: : So it’s fine if you continue being a horrible excuse for a teacher. I’m not going to do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 所以您可以继续当个糟糕透顶的老师，我不会管的。

lines.en: : Well...Thanks then, Ms. Watabe.
lines.zh: : 那……谢了，Watabe 老师。

lines.en: : Wakana, please.
lines.zh: : 叫我 Wakana 就好。

lines.en: : Then thanks, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 那谢谢了，Wakana。

lines.en: : And how should I refer to you? Arakawa?
lines.zh: : 那我该怎么称呼您？Arakawa？

lines.en: : Just Sensei is fine.
lines.zh: : 叫 Sensei 就行。

lines.en: : Oh, you're serious?
lines.zh: : 哦，您是认真的？

lines.en: : I thought there was a joke coming.
lines.zh: : 我还以为后面接了个笑话。

lines.en: : For a moment, I almost even looked forward to it.
lines.zh: : 有那么一瞬间，我甚至还有点期待。

lines.en: : Do you...like jokes?
lines.zh: : 您……喜欢笑话？

lines.en: : I don’t like anything.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不喜欢。

lines.en: : I just want to sleep forever and never have to teach again.
lines.zh: : 我只想永远睡下去，再也不用教书。

lines.en: : Why even become a teacher?
lines.zh: : 那当初为什么当老师？

lines.en: : Who knows?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？

lines.en: : I’d ask you the same question but I’m pretty sure it’s the same reason all [young]men become teachers.
lines.zh: : 我本来也想问您同样的问题，但我敢肯定，您当老师的理由和所有[young]男人一样。

lines.en: : I’m not that bad...
lines.zh: : 我没那么糟糕吧……

lines.en: : You’re not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : Sensei! Are you available right now? There’s something I need to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : Sensei！您现在有空吗？我有事想跟您谈。

lines.en: Ah, there we go. I’m sure Makoto will be willing to vouch for me and make me sound like less of the...person I actually am to this other educational-professional.
lines.zh: 啊，来了。我相信 Makoto 会愿意替我作证，让我在这位教育界同行面前听起来不那么像……我真正的样子。

lines.en: : Watch this. My class-rep will vouch for me.
lines.zh: : 看着吧。我的班长会替我作证。

lines.en: : What? I can’t just leave?
lines.zh: : 什么？我不能就这么走了？

lines.en: : Didn’t you come in here to complain? Where’s the harm in killing a little more time?
lines.zh: : 您进来不就是为了发牢骚吗？再多消磨一点时间又有什么坏处？

lines.en: : Umm...Are you going to answer me or should I just come back later?
lines.zh: : 呃……您要回答我吗，还是我过会儿再来？

lines.en: : Sorry, Makoto. Come on in.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Makoto。进来吧。

lines.en: scene watabesan7
Makoto walks in and drops an even larger stack of papers on my desk.
lines.zh: Makoto 走进来，往我桌上又摞了一堆更大的文件。

lines.en: My sanity begins to slip away and I contemplate taking up a suicide pact with Wakana after all.
lines.zh: 我的理智开始流失，我甚至认真考虑起要不要干脆跟 Wakana 立那个自杀契约。

lines.en: : Oh. Ms. Watabe is here.
lines.zh: : 哦。Watabe 老师在啊。

lines.en: : Are any of us really here?
lines.zh: : 我们真的有谁在这儿吗？

lines.en: scene watabesan8
: Are the two of you friends? I can’t say I’ve ever seen you together before.
lines.zh: : 两位是朋友吗？我以前好像从没见过你们在一起。

lines.en: : This is our first time meeting but I’m pretty sure the two of us are going to die together.
lines.zh: : 我们今天是第一次见面，但我敢肯定，我们俩会一起死。

lines.en: : No. We’re all going to die alone.
lines.zh: : 不。我们都会孤独地死去。

lines.en: : I’m a little shocked by the eerily good chemistry between you two, but I’m just going to chalk it up to end-of-day woes.
lines.zh: : 两位之间那种诡异的默契让我有点吃惊，不过我就当是临近下班的那股怨气好了。

lines.en: : Life itself is woe. Never-ending woe.
lines.zh: : 人生本身就是苦难。无尽的苦难。

lines.en: : The transfer thing is really getting to you two, huh?
lines.zh: : 转学这件事真的把两位折腾坏了吧？

lines.en: : That’s actually why I’m here. I just wanted to make sure you-
lines.zh: : 其实这正是我来的原因。我只是想确认您——

lines.en: : Wait, before that, I need you to confirm to Ms. Watabe that I am not a horrible teacher.
lines.zh: : 等等，在那之前，我需要你向 Watabe 老师证明我不是个糟糕的老师。

lines.en: scene watabesan9
: Are you in danger, Miyamura?
lines.zh: : 你现在有危险吗，Miyamura？

lines.en: : He hasn’t put a collar on you yet, has he?
lines.zh: : 他还没给你戴上项圈吧？

lines.en: One day...
lines.zh: 总有一天……

lines.en: : A...collar?
lines.zh: : 项……项圈？

lines.en: : May I inquire as to what this is all about?
lines.zh: : 我可以请问一下这到底是怎么回事吗？

lines.en: : I’m just trying to protect the girls of this[school].
lines.zh: : 我只是想保护这所[school]里的女生。

lines.en: : You called your entire class miscreants like five minutes ago and openly hate your job.
lines.zh: : 您五分钟前还把全班叫成问题儿童，而且毫不掩饰地讨厌自己的工作。

lines.en: scene watabesan10
: Uh...I’m not quite sure what’s going on here...but Sensei isn’t nearly as bad as the rumors suggest.
lines.zh: : 呃……我不太清楚现在是什么情况……但 Sensei 远没有传闻里说的那么差。

lines.en: : He’s not?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : What rumors are even being circulated about me?
lines.zh: : 到底在流传关于我的什么传闻？

lines.en: : I only converse with the girls in my class and not any of the teachers, so I don’t even-
lines.zh: : 我只跟班上的女生说话，根本不跟任何老师来往，所以我连——

lines.en: : Oh, okay. I think I get it.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。我想我明白了。

lines.en: scene watabesan11
: It’s fine. If Miyamura says you’re a good teacher, I have no reason to disbelieve her.
lines.zh: : 没关系。既然 Miyamura 说您是个好老师，我就没有理由不信。

lines.en: : She’s one of the only good students I know.
lines.zh: : 她是我认识的为数不多的好学生之一。

lines.en: : I even tried to poach her for my class but she vehemently refused, electing to keep fixing your mistakes instead.
lines.zh: : 我甚至想把她挖到我班上来，但她坚决拒绝了，选择继续替您收拾烂摊子。

lines.en: : You tried to steal one of my students without even telling me?
lines.zh: : 您想挖我的学生，连跟我说都不说一声？

lines.en: : Just the one. To make up for it, you can have anyone from my class that you like.
lines.zh: : 就那一个。作为补偿，我班上随便您挑一个走。

lines.en: : Twelve is already way too much for me.
lines.zh: : 十二个对我来说已经太多了。

lines.en: : Pathetic. I have thirty and I’m about to get even more.
lines.zh: : 真可悲。我有三十个，而且马上还要更多。

lines.en: : Jesus. How big is your classroom?
lines.zh: : 天哪。您那教室多大啊？

lines.en: : Too fucking big. Get me out of this hell, please.
lines.zh: : 他妈的太大了。求您把我从这个地狱里弄出去吧。

lines.en: scene watabesan12
: Oh, apologies for the language, Miyamura.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉说了粗话，Miyamura。

lines.en: : I don’t often get to talk with people my own age, so I must have let my true self slip for a moment.
lines.zh: : 我平时很少有机会和同龄人说话，所以一时让真实的自己露了馅。

lines.en: : Oh, I don’t mind. Sensei speaks like that all the time.
lines.zh: : 哦，我不介意。Sensei 一直都是这么说话的。

lines.en: scene watabesan13
: He does, does he?
lines.zh: : 是吗，是吗？

lines.en: scene watabesan14
: Oh, n-not in[school], of course! I just mean when the two of us are together after[school]!
lines.zh: : 哦，当、当然不是在[school]里！我是说我们两个下[school]后在一起的时候！

lines.en: : You hang out and curse with your students after[school]?
lines.zh: : 你下了[school]还跟学生一起鬼混、一起骂脏话？

lines.en: : Thanks, Makoto. You really helped clear my name for me.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Makoto。你可真是帮我洗清了罪名。

lines.en: scene watabesan15
: Hah...
: Not like it really matters to me...
lines.zh: : 反正对我来说也没什么所谓……

lines.en: : No point in putting any effort into anything when we’re all just going to get sucked into the void when we least expect it.
lines.zh: : 反正我们迟早会在最意想不到的时候被吸进虚空，何必对什么事上心。

lines.en: : Does that mean you’ll be coming back to complain to me more often from now on?
lines.zh: : 这是不是说，您以后会常来找我发牢骚？

lines.en: scene watabesan16
: Agreeing would imply that I put actual thought into my actions.
lines.zh: : 答应下来，就等于承认我对自己的行为真的动过脑子。

lines.en: : Is that...not a thing you normally do?
lines.zh: : 那……不是您平时会做的事吗？

lines.en: : It’s not.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Why bother putting thought into anything when-
lines.zh: : 既然反正都要死，何必还对什么事动脑子——

lines.en: : We’re all just going to die anyway, right?
lines.zh: : 反正我们都要死，对吧？

lines.en: : Right.
: See? You’re starting to get it.
lines.zh: : 看吧？您开始懂了。

lines.en: : As...much as I’d hate to interrupt...whatever is happening right now, I do need to start going over the transfer process with you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 虽然……我很不想打断……现在这不知所谓的场面，但我确实得开始跟您过一遍转学流程了，Sensei。

lines.en: : It’s a little different this time given the amount of girls who will be moving into the[school].
lines.zh: : 这次情况有点不一样，因为要转进这所[school]的女生人数很多。

lines.en: : Maybe Ms. Watabe can stay around to hear your explanation as well? I know she’s struggling too.
lines.zh: : 也许 Watabe 老师也可以留下来一起听您说明？我知道她也挺难的。

lines.en: : I’m not struggling with this, I just hate it.
lines.zh: : 我不是难，我只是讨厌这事。

lines.en: : I finally had some time to breathe with Molly leaving and now I have to deal with even more transfer students. What if they’re worse?
lines.zh: : Molly 走了，我好不容易能喘口气，现在又得应付更多转学生。万一她们更糟怎么办？

lines.en: : Just so you’re aware, the transfers are coming from Kumon-mi, not Dublin.
lines.zh: : 提醒您一下，转学生是从 Kumon-mi 来的，不是 Dublin。

lines.en: : I don't think Molly's country of origin has any bearing on her-
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Molly 的祖国跟她的——

lines.en: : I don’t care where they’re coming from. I just want them to shut up and do their fucking work.
lines.zh: : 我才不管她们从哪儿来。我只想让她们闭嘴，把他妈的作业做完。

lines.en: scene watabesan17
: Oh. Sorry again, Miyamura.
lines.zh: : 哦。又说对不起了，Miyamura。

lines.en: : You shouldn’t have to hear that.
lines.zh: : 你不该听到这些。

lines.en: : It’s fine...I even feel like I learned a thing or two about you today, Ms. Watabe.
lines.zh: : 没关系的……我觉得今天甚至还多了解了您一点呢，Watabe 老师。

lines.en: : Does this mean you’ll leave this man and come keep my class in-line instead of his?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着你会离开这个男人，来替我管班而不是替他管？

lines.en: : At least be considerate enough to not do this in front of me. Poach her behind my back.
lines.zh: : 至少体谅一下，别当着我的面挖人。要挖就背着我挖。

lines.en: scene watabesan18
: Didn’t you just complain about me doing that a minute or two ago? Give me a break.
lines.zh: : 您一两分钟前不是还在抱怨我这么干吗？饶了我吧。

lines.en: : Again...I’d really like to go over this transfer thing sooner rather than later...
lines.zh: : 再说一次……我真的很想尽早过一遍转学的事……

lines.en: scene watabesan19
: Of course...I need to get going anyway...
lines.zh: : 当然……我也该走了……

lines.en: : Big plans, Wakana?
lines.zh: : 有什么大计划吗，Wakana？

lines.en: : Yes. Sleeping for the next sixteen hours.
lines.zh: : 有。接下来十六个小时睡觉。

lines.en: : Good day, Miyamura. Sensei...
lines.zh: : 再见，Miyamura。Sensei……

lines.en: scene watabesan20
Ms. Watabe leaves and things suddenly become normal again with one less dark cloud floating around in my office.
lines.zh: Watabe 老师走了，办公室里少了一朵飘来飘去的乌云，一切突然又恢复了正常。

lines.en: : Wakana?...
lines.zh: : Wakana？……

lines.en: : You two are on a first-name basis now?
lines.zh: : 你们两个已经直呼其名了？

lines.en: : It appears that way.
lines.zh: : 看起来是。

lines.en: : Ahh...It feels like just the other day, a certain student-council president suffered a panic attack when I referred to her by her first name.
lines.zh: : 啊……感觉就像前两天的事，某位学生会长因为我直呼她名字而惊恐发作。

lines.en: scene watabesan21
: O-Obviously! You just started doing it out of nowhere one day and I had to learn to adapt!
lines.zh: : 当、当然！您某天突然就开始这么叫了，我只能学着适应！

lines.en: : I haven’t freaked out about that in a long time, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我已经很久没为这个崩溃了，Sensei！

lines.en: : Yeah, because now we have sex.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为我们现在上床了。

lines.en: scene watabesan22
: Ugh...Can we just go over this packet now? I’m not in the mood to discuss our weird relationship dynamic today.
lines.zh: : 呃……我们现在能直接过这份文件吗？我今天没心情讨论我们那诡异的关系。

lines.en: : Can you give me the watered-down version and just omit the stuff you’re going to do yourself?
lines.zh: : 你能给我个精简版，把你自己会去做的部分都省掉吗？

lines.en: scene watabesan23
: That’s...pretty much everything, though.
lines.zh: : 可……那几乎就是全部内容了啊。

lines.en: : Cool. Well, thanks for stopping by then. See you later, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 好的。那谢谢你顺路过来。回头见，Makoto。

lines.en: scene watabesan24
: Can I at least warn you that we’re going to be getting our first new girl this week?
lines.zh: : 至少让我提醒您一句，这周我们就会迎来第一个新女生？

lines.en: : That soon?
lines.zh: : 这么快？

lines.en: : Do you know who she is yet?
lines.zh: : 你知道她是谁了吗？

lines.en: scene watabesan23
: A girl named Uta Ushibori. I looked into her file and she’s not...the brightest.
lines.zh: : 一个叫 Uta Ushibori 的女生。我查了她的档案，她……不太聪明。

lines.en: : She’s not quite as far behind as someone like Miku, but she’s definitely not up to par with the rest of us.
lines.zh: : 她还不至于像 Miku 那样落后那么多，但肯定跟不上我们其他人。

lines.en: : How do you even gauge everyone’s level when I’ve stopped assigning work?
lines.zh: : 我都不布置作业了，你到底怎么衡量大家的水平？

lines.en: : Keeping track of everyone’s level is the mark of a good teacher. I need to pay attention to things like this or I’ll never make it anywhere in life.
lines.zh: : 掌握每个人的水平是好老师的标志。我必须留意这些事，否则我这辈子都不会有出息。

lines.en: : You’re still thinking of becoming a teacher?
lines.zh: : 你还在考虑当老师？

lines.en: : Of course. Have I ever expressed any doubt that would contradict that?
lines.zh: : 当然。我有表现出过任何与此矛盾的犹豫吗？

lines.en: : I...guess not.
lines.zh: : 我……想是没有。

lines.en: : Huh.
: Well anyway, Uta should be showing up sometime over the next few days along with the first “batch” of new girls.
lines.zh: : 总之，Uta 应该会在接下来几天内，跟着第一批新女生一起出现。

lines.en: : There are quite a few of them given that their former[school] was rather large, so most classes will see sizable increases in the near future.
lines.zh: : 她们之前的[school]规模不小，所以人数相当多，大多数班级在近期都会迎来可观的增长。

lines.en: : We’ll only be receiving Uta with the first wave, though.
lines.zh: : 不过第一波我们只会收到 Uta 一个人。

lines.en: : Really? The[school] is getting that many new girls and we’re only getting one?
lines.zh: : 真的？[school]要来那么多新女生，我们只分到一个？

lines.en: : Is that actually disappointing to-
lines.zh: : 这么说您其实是失望——

lines.en: scene watabesan25
: Don’t tell me you’re thinking of expanding your harem during a time like this?...
lines.zh: : 您该不会是在这种时候还想着扩充后宫吧？……

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how much was lost in the collapse? Millions of Yen and personal belongings, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 您知道那场塌方损失了多少吗？几百万日元，还有大家的私人物品，Sensei。

lines.en: : Granted, one of the girls who went there comes from an extremely wealthy family, so it’s already being rebuilt...but still.
lines.zh: : 诚然，在那儿上学的一个女生家里极有钱，所以已经在重建了……但即便如此。

lines.en: : Show some consideration for everyone, please.
lines.zh: : 请您替大家着想一下。

lines.en: : For all we know, this Uta girl might seriously be struggling with that.
lines.zh: : 说不定这个 Uta 正为此痛苦不堪呢。

lines.en: : Then I’m sure she’ll be pleased to find out that her life is about to get a hell of a lot easier.
lines.zh: : 那她一定会很高兴地发现，她的日子马上就要轻松太多了。

lines.en: : Or exponentially more difficult if she’s anything like me.
lines.zh: : 要是她有半点像我，那就会成倍地更难。

lines.en: : She’s probably not. You’re kind of one-in-a-million, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。你可是万里挑一，Makoto。

lines.en: scene watabesan26
: Heheh~ I’m going to go out on a limb and assume you mean that as a compliment so I don’t have to strangle you with your stupid, brightly-colored tie.
lines.zh: : 呵呵~我就大胆当这是夸奖了，这样就不用拿你那条蠢兮兮的亮色领带勒死你了。
